item.title: 10-Minute Ocean Sounds Meditation on a Moonlit Sea
item.description: A ready-to-play 10-minute meditation with ocean wave sounds and a moving moonlit sea in the background. Start with one click; free and no sign-up.

item.title: 10-Minute Space Meditation with the 52 Hz Whale Song
item.description: Ten quiet minutes with a slowly spinning galaxy and the song of the 52 Hz whale in the background. A ready-to-play meditation that starts with one click; free, no sign-up.

item.title: Box Breathing: How to Do the 4-4-4-4 Technique, Step by Step
item.description: A step-by-step guide to box breathing (4-4-4-4 or square breathing): inhale, hold, exhale and pause for four seconds each. Includes a free guided exercise.

item.title: How to Meditate for Beginners: A Simple 5-Minute Guide
item.description: What is meditation and where do you start? A simple beginner's guide to how to sit, what to do with a busy mind, and how to turn meditation into a habit.
